name: Dubuffet cells
description: Abstract cell drawings like a wild hand-drawn floor plan: the whole surface broken into irregular, asymmetric cells: a mix of big blocky cells, medium cells and a few long bent corridors of varying width, with L, U and branching shapes, odd notches and bulges, straight runs meeting rounded corners. Most large cells hold smaller cells inside them, nested two or three levels deep; thick black outlines. Each cell is thin parallel red or blue stripes at its own angle, plain brushy white, or a small solid colour patch. Purely abstract, no faces, figures or objects.
light: no light source, flat colour on white
white cells and black outlines on a black ground
muted earth tones: pink, grey and ochre cells on beige paper
bright red, blue and black hatching on pure white
composition: all-over cells to every edge, big blocky cells with smaller cells nested inside, many small cells packed around them, a few corridors; asymmetric and off-grid, cells lean and tilt, no ground or horizon
one big irregular cluster of cells, isolated on plain ground
a dense maze of cells in loose bands, like a map of an imaginary city seen from above
loose looping lines over a dark ground, cells half formed
camera_or_medium: marker, felt pen and vinyl paint on paper or panel; flat, confident black contour
texture_detail: thin straight hand-drawn stripes with gaps two to three times the line width and lots of white between them; each cell has its own stripe angle, many diagonal (30, 45, 60 degrees), some horizontal or vertical; saturated, bold red or blue; thick black outlines of uneven weight, a thin red dashed line hugging the inside edge of only some of them (about a third), never down the middle of a shape; white fills show brush strokes; fills roughly 40% striped, 40% white, 20% small solid patches (red, blue, pale blue, grey, black); visible hand wobble
avoid: jigsaw puzzle pieces, tabs and sockets
grid alignment, rows and columns of cells
dashed centre lines like road markings
uniform-width corridors, worm or snake shapes
subjects: an endless hand-drawn floor plan of nested striped and white cells
a single floating cluster of lumpy cells
bands of red and blue hatched cells like a striped map
looping black contours half closing into cells on a dark ground
